title: 第 二十一章 黑莲挑食第二十二章 二层后期
slug: 双穿美利坚人狱苟到玄幻发育
content_zh:
厨房中，郑宏雪揭开锅盖的瞬间，浓白的蒸汽如云涌起。
一股醇厚的肉香随之弥散开来，顷刻盈满整个院子。
她抬起手，在氤氲的雾气前轻轻扇动，露出一锅中炖得酥软的肉块。
利落地将肉块尽数捞起，盛进一旁的木盆中。
盆沿还冒着热气，端至院子，轻轻搁在了木板面上，低着头又坐在灶前。
此时，林枫才看清郑宏雪全貌。
个子不高，走路还一瘸一瘸的，是个跛脚姑娘。
上衣穿着一件青色窄袖的短衫，长度及腰。
下身是一件裤腿宽大的长裤，脚踝处用绑腿（腿带）束紧。
身上的衣服明显是城主府下等的佣人装扮，一般上等的女佣都是穿着裙子。
郑宏文递给林枫一双筷子，“林师兄，快吃”
林枫望着在厨房忙乎的郑宏雪觉得这姑娘有些可怜，“给你妹留一份”
郑宏文还想说什么，就听到郑宏雪：“不了...你们吃，锅里还有”
林枫当然知道她在说谎，“郑师弟，给她留一份”
“没问题”
郑宏文用筷子夹了几块肉，放到了厨房里。
随即，林枫打开干荷叶。
露出里面的泡椒鸡爪和花生米。
对于这陌生的食物，郑宏文有些疑惑。
“林师兄这是什么？”

“哦下酒菜”说着拿出酒葫芦摇了摇。
郑宏文尴尬道：“林师兄家里也没个酒杯之类的”
“没事，用碗喝也行”
说完，林枫打开了酒葫芦，给郑宏文倒了一碗。
一股浓郁的酒香袭来，郑宏文眼睛一亮，咽了咽口水。
“林师兄，这酒...这酒也太珍贵了”
平日里，就连那些浑浊的酒水都舍不得喝，像这种酒香四溢，还清澈无比的酒水更是极品。
甚至见都没见过。
林枫笑道：“你是我第一个朋友，既然是朋友，就不要客气，来干”
“好”
郑宏文小心翼翼的端起酒碗，生怕洒了一滴。
抿了一口，霎时间，一股辛辣传来。
呛的他阵阵咳嗽。
“对不起啊林师兄，我..我从未喝过这种烈酒”
林枫笑道：“第一次喝烈酒都这样，其实我酒量也一般，慢饮就行。
content_en:
In the kitchen, the moment Zheng Hongxue opened the lid of the pot, thick white steam surged up like clouds.
A mellow aroma of meat spread out and filled the whole yard instantly.
She raised her hand and gently flapped it in front of the mist, revealing the tender meat stewed in the pot.
He scooped up all the pieces of meat neatly and put them into the wooden basin on the side.
Steam was still rising from the edge of the basin. He carried it to the yard, placed it gently on the wooden board, and sat in front of the stove again with his head lowered.
Only then did Lin Feng see Zheng Hongxue's whole face.
She is not tall and walks with a limp. She is a lame girl.
The top is a cyan short-sleeved shirt with narrow sleeves, reaching waist length.
The lower body is a pair of trousers with wide legs and gaiters (leg straps) fastened at the ankles.
The clothes on her body are obviously the clothes of a lower-class servant in the city lord's mansion. Generally, the upper-class maids wear skirts.
Zheng Hongwen handed Lin Feng a pair of chopsticks, "Senior Brother Lin, eat quickly."
Lin Feng looked at Zheng Hongxue who was busy in the kitchen and felt that this girl was a little pitiful, "Leave a portion for your sister."
Zheng Hongwen wanted to say something else, but he heard Zheng Hongxue: "No...you guys eat, there's still more in the pot."
Of course Lin Feng knew she was lying, "Junior Brother Zheng, leave a copy for her."
“No problem”
Zheng Hongwen picked up a few pieces of meat with chopsticks and put them in the kitchen.
Immediately, Lin Feng opened the dried lotus leaves.
Reveal the pickled pepper chicken feet and peanuts inside.
Zheng Hongwen was a little confused about this unfamiliar food.
"Senior Brother Lin, what is this?"
"Oh, appetizers," he said, taking out the wine gourd and shaking it.
Zheng Hongwen said awkwardly: "Senior Brother Lin doesn't have a wine glass at home."
"It's okay, you can drink from a bowl."
After saying that, Lin Feng opened the wine gourd and poured a bowl for Zheng Hongwen.
A strong aroma of wine hit him. Zheng Hongwen's eyes lit up and he swallowed.
"Senior Brother Lin, this wine... this wine is too precious."
On weekdays, even those turbid drinks are reluctant to drink, but a drink like this that is fragrant and crystal clear is the best.
Never even seen it.
Lin Feng smiled and said: "You are my first friend. Since we are friends, don't be polite and come and do it."
"good"
Zheng Hongwen carefully picked up the wine bowl, for fear of spilling a drop.
After taking a sip, I felt a spiciness all of a sudden.
He choked and coughed.
"I'm sorry, Senior Brother Lin, I...I have never drunk such strong alcohol before"
Lin Feng smiled and said: "This is the first time I drink strong liquor. In fact, my capacity for drinking is average, so I just need to drink slowly.
